description: This file contains integration tests for the /tasks API endpoints in a FastAPI application, verifying authentication, pagination, ownership, and modification of task resources via HTTP requests using TestClient.

methods.name: test_auth_required_on_all_routes(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Verifies that all /tasks endpoints require authentication by examining 401 responses.

methods.name: test_create_task_and_get_list_pagination(client: TestClient, auth_header, seed_tasks)
methods.description: Tests task creation with invalid payload, multiple task creation, and pagination retrieval scoped to user.

methods.name: test_get_task_and_ownership_enforced(client: TestClient, auth_header, seed_tasks)
methods.description: Ensures task retrieval respects ownership, returning 200 for owner and 404 for cross-user or missing tasks.

methods.name: test_put_update_task_and_validation(client: TestClient, auth_header, seed_tasks)
methods.description: Verifies full task update, validation errors, cross-user update restrictions, and not found handling.

methods.name: test_toggle_task_completion(client: TestClient, auth_header, seed_tasks)
methods.description: Tests toggling task completion status both implicitly and explicitly, with cross-user and not found cases.

methods.name: test_delete_task_only_owner(client: TestClient, auth_header, seed_tasks)
methods.description: Checks that only task owners can delete tasks, including rejection for cross-user deletion and handling of already deleted tasks.
